caption:
What should you tell a clinic before a treatment, even if it seems unrelated?
More than most people do, and the useful items rarely feel connected to your face.

Five things get asked before energy-based work: implants and electronic devices, injections in the recent past, pregnancy, anything active on the skin, and current or recently finished medication. Nobody hides these. People simply do not think to say them, because none of them are about the face.

The reasons are mechanical rather than statistical. Energy does not stop at the skin it is aimed at. Two treatments given weeks apart can meet under the surface. A course of medication you finished can leave healing not quite back to normal. And treating over active inflammation is a different decision from treating calm skin.

Three that almost never make it onto the form: what was injected in the last six weeks and where, a course you stopped months ago, and a device that sits below the neck.

If you are not sure whether something matters, that uncertainty is the reason to say it.

General education only.

#InformedConsent #AestheticConsultation #KoreanAesthetics #MedicalAesthetics #BetterDecisions
